# Cognify

> Cognify is an open-source web study workspace for turning a learner's own notes and PDFs into summaries, flashcards, quizzes, and source-grounded study help.

## Public pages

- Home: https://cognify-alpha.vercel.app/
- About and methodology: https://cognify-alpha.vercel.app/about
- Privacy and data handling: https://cognify-alpha.vercel.app/privacy
- Source code: https://github.com/plut0000/Cognify

## Important context

- Cognify is an online-only software project, not a physical school or local business.
- Generated study material should be checked against the learner's original source.
- Public marketing pages may be indexed. Account, API, sign-in, and private workspace routes should not be indexed.
- The project is licensed under the MIT License.
